messages:
Emma (Sales): FYI — Greenline Health requested a 3-week HIPAA POC. They want a quick scoping doc: success criteria, sample prompts/evals, timeline, security artifacts (DPA/BAA, SOC2), pen-test window, and pricing. Who can take the presales lead?
Raj (SE): I can own tech presales. Quick questions: will PHI be included in requests during the POC or can they de-identify? expected QPS / typical seq len? do they need streaming? If PHI flows we should recommend Dedicated or Private with a signed BAA.
Emma (Sales): They confirmed PHI will be used in a subset of tests (they said they can provide redacted variants too). Sales wants to start Mon Apr 6 and run ~3 weeks. Prefer to start on Hosted to reduce ramp friction if security accepts BAA + BYOK.
Maria (Security): Security checklist (high level): signed BAA (HIPAA), DPA for GDPR, SOC2 Type II report, encryption at rest/in-transit details, KMS/BYOK options, data flow diagram, retention & deletion policy, staff access control & MFA proof, and a scoped pen-test agreement. I can share SOC2 + our BAA template. Links: <https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-latest> <https://redwood.internal/templates/baa>.
Raj (SE): Draft success criteria proposal (technical):
- p50 token latency < 180ms, p95 < 500ms for 512-token sequences
- Throughput: sustain 50 RPS with batching (POC baseline)
- Accuracy on evaluation set (n=200 clinical prompts): top-1 correctness >= 92%
- Hallucination rate < 2% (manual adjudication on flagged outputs)
- Cost target: host cost <= $120 per 100k tokens (placeholder, refine with pricing)
I'll prepare two prompt sets: (A) redacted-PHI and (B) PHI-included.
Emma (Sales): Please draft 8–12 sample eval prompts we can show the customer. Sales needs that for the SOW.
Raj (SE): Sample eval snippet (for meds extraction / summary):
```
# Eval prompt 001 (extract meds)
Input: "Patient notes: Patient reports starting metformin 500 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg nightly."
Task: list medications and dosages in JSON: {"medications": [{"name":..., "dose":...}]}
Metrics: exact-match for med names, dosage F1, hallucination flag
```
Maria (Security): Pen-test notes: customers often request a penetration test window limited to the POC environment. We require a pre-scan questionnaire and an approved scope. We can agree to a 1–2 week testing window after the POC environment is provisioned. Also confirm that logs retention can be reduced and that cached KV is disabled for PHI unless on Dedicated with encryption.
Ben (PM): Product/ops notes: Hosted + BAA is supported with customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS for key isolation. Dedicated gives stronger isolation and lower noisy-neighbor risk; typical Dedicated minimum commit is ~ $15k–$40k/month depending on sizing. I'll produce a pricing range for: pay-as-you-go Hosted, short-term Dedicated trial, and private deployment. Also confirm we can enable tighter retention (7 days) for the POC.
Raj (SE): Operational items: we'll provision a scoped POC project, rotate scoped API keys, and enable audit logging. Default log retention is 30d, can set to 7d for this POC. We'll disable prefix caching and recommend request-level encryption for PHI. I will provision an evaluation harness that computes exact-match / F1 / hallucination rate and produces a simple report.
deploy-bot: POC environment 'greenline-poc' has been created in staging-us-west-2. Test API key issued (rotated).
Emma (Sales): Next steps — action items: @Raj to deliver the 200-prompt eval set + metric definitions by EOD tomorrow; @Maria to attach BAA + SOC2 link and DPA template; @Ben to send a 1-page pricing options summary (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and minimum commit scenarios. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Greenline for Tuesday morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
